# dify_dataset_document (Resource)

Manages a document inside a Dify knowledge base (dataset). The document is created from text and indexed asynchronously. Set `indexing_wait = false` to skip blocking on indexing and use `dify_dataset_document_indexing_wait` instead. Import by `dataset_id:document_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a knowledge base (dataset).
resource "dify_dataset" "kb" {
  name               = "My Knowledge Base"
  description        = "Documents for RAG retrieval."
  indexing_technique = "high_quality"
  permission         = "all_team_members"
}

# Document content is sourced from a local file, so the knowledge base can be
# maintained like a code repository: edit `document.md` and run `terraform apply`.
resource "dify_dataset_document" "doc" {
  dataset_id    = dify_dataset.kb.id
  name          = "Example Document"
  text          = file("${path.module}/document.md")
  doc_form      = "text_model"
  doc_language  = "English"
  indexing_wait = false
}

# Wait for the document's indexing to complete with a custom timeout.
resource "dify_dataset_document_indexing_wait" "wait" {
  dataset_id       = dify_dataset_document.doc.dataset_id
  document_id      = dify_dataset_document.doc.id
  timeout          = 600
  polling_interval = 5

  depends_on = [dify_dataset_document.doc]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) The knowledge base this document belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.
- `name` (String) Document name.

### Optional

- `doc_form` (String) `text_model` for standard text chunking, `hierarchical_model` for parent-child chunk structure, `qa_model` for question-answer pair extraction.
- `doc_language` (String) Language of the document for processing optimization.
- `embedding_model` (String) Embedding model name.
- `embedding_model_provider` (String) Embedding model provider.
- `indexing_poll_interval` (Number) Seconds between indexing status polls when `indexing_wait` is true.
- `indexing_technique` (String) `high_quality` uses embedding models for precise search; `economy` uses keyword-based indexing. Required when adding the first document to a knowledge base.
- `indexing_timeout` (Number) Maximum seconds to wait for indexing to finish when `indexing_wait` is true.
- `indexing_wait` (Boolean) Whether Create/Update block until the document's indexing reaches `available`.
- `process_rule` (String) Processing rules for chunking as a JSON string.
- `retrieval_model` (String) Retrieval model configuration as a JSON string.
- `text` (String, Sensitive) Document text content. Write-only and sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the document is archived.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix seconds when the document was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the document is enabled for retrieval.
- `id` (String) Document ID (assigned by Dify).
- `indexing_error` (String) Indexing error message when status is `failed`.
- `indexing_status` (String) Current document status (`queuing`, `indexing`, `paused`, `available`, `failed`, `disabled`, `archived`).
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix seconds when the document was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Documents are imported by "dataset_id:document_id".
terraform import dify_dataset_document.doc <dataset_id>:<document_id>
```
